verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers monday's AI-agent/MCP/developer platform and general community complaints about product quality, but contains no evidence about monday's no-code automation recipe builder (e.g., 'when X then Y' workflows) that a PM would use without code. Since this axis clearly applies to a work-management platform like monday.com, but no supporting evidence is present, this is 'none' rather than 'na'.
